in_hebrew.name: Marvin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend or little servant
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marvin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Marvin is derived from the Old English 'Mægwein' meaning 'little servant' or 'magician'. The name gained popularity in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages, and was later popularized by the character Marvin Monroe in the 1960s American television series 'Maverick'.
